publishedMetadata.title: Query keys and caching
publishedMetadata.description: A practical TanStack Query 5 lesson on query keys and caching, with a real starter bug, instructor repair, HTTP/cache invariants and a separate browser or Next SSR acceptance exercise.
objectives: Design stable structured query keys containing every filter and pass the Query signal to the actual HTTP request.
Switch between todo and done. Inspect Query Devtools and verify different keys; no cross-filter content leakage. Cancel a request by switching rapidly.
Never include access tokens or raw private task titles in a query key; tenant scope belongs in a secure key namespace and server authorization.
